page.title: Analyze a receipt before reconciling it
page.intro: We detect signs of manipulation, digital provenance and inconsistencies to help you review a transfer.
upload.dropzone.heading: Drag or select a receipt
upload.dropzone.constraints: PNG, JPG or WebP · 10 MB max
upload.preview.name: Name
upload.pipeline.heading: What this analysis does
upload.pipeline.step.upload.title: You upload the receipt
upload.pipeline.step.upload.detail: You drag or pick a receipt image in PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
upload.pipeline.step.validation.title: We validate the file
upload.pipeline.step.validation.detail: We check format, size and dimensions before analysing the content.
upload.pipeline.step.provenance.title: We inspect metadata and provenance
upload.pipeline.step.provenance.detail: We read the file metadata and C2PA content credentials when they are present.
upload.pipeline.step.extraction.title: We extract the data with OCR
upload.pipeline.step.extraction.detail: The service reads amount, date, CBU/CVU and CUIT/CUIL from the receipt with its own OCR.
upload.pipeline.step.identifiers.title: We validate the identifiers
upload.pipeline.step.identifiers.detail: We check the verification digits of the extracted CBU/CVU and CUIT/CUIL.
upload.pipeline.step.vision.title: We inspect the image visually
upload.pipeline.step.vision.detail: PyTorch-based visual feature extraction integrated into the document inspection pipeline.
upload.pipeline.step.scoring.title: We compute risk and confidence
upload.pipeline.step.scoring.detail: We combine the signals into a risk score and an analysis confidence value.
pipeline.section.heading: How the service works
pipeline.integration.heading: The same API, from your bot
pipeline.integration.description: The public API is the same one this site uses: a WhatsApp, Telegram or any messaging-app bot can send it a receipt and get back the same risk result.
apiCallout.heading: This site is a manual-verification demo
apiCallout.body: The product is the public API: it's built for messaging bots or systems that receive thousands of receipts a day to call it directly. This site just exposes that same API so you can try it by hand.
docsPage.title: Documentation
docsPage.intro: Open-source engine for analyzing images of Argentine transfer receipts and returning an explainable fraud-risk assessment.
docsPage.product.heading: What this project is
docsPage.product.body: The system does not certify that a transfer exists and does not issue an absolute "real" or "fake" verdict. It inspects the submitted artifact, extracts financial data, collects technical evidence and returns a reproducible risk score that helps a beneficiary perform manual reconciliation.
docsPage.product.principle: No evidence of fraud != proof of authenticity
docsPage.scope.heading: What it does and doesn't do (MVP 1)
docsPage.scope.in.fileValidation: File format and safety validation (JPEG, PNG, WebP)
docsPage.scope.in.hashing: SHA-256 calculation without retaining the image
docsPage.scope.in.c2pa: C2PA / Content Credentials inspection when present
docsPage.scope.in.ocr: Local OCR, no paid model tokens
docsPage.scope.in.extraction: Extraction of amount, date, CBU/CVU, CUIT/CUIL
docsPage.architecture.heading: Architecture
docsPage.architecture.body: The frontend is never the source of truth for scoring. FastAPI owns validation, orchestration and the public contract. Analyzer implementations are replaceable adapters, and the risk engine is deterministic and versioned.
docsPage.architecture.flow.client: The client (this site, a messaging bot or any app) sends the receipt as multipart/form-data
docsPage.architecture.flow.api: FastAPI validates the file and orchestrates the analysis
docsPage.architecture.flow.analyzers: Parallel analyzers: metadata/C2PA, OCR, visual inspection and financial rules
docsPage.architecture.flow.engine: The risk engine combines the signals into a deterministic score
docsPage.architecture.fullDocsLink: Read the full architecture on GitHub →
docsPage.api.heading: Using the API
docsPage.api.body: The public API needs no access token in MVP 1 and accepts the receipt as multipart/form-data.
docsPage.api.note: Subject to file-size limits and a per-IP request rate limit.
docsPage.stack.heading: Stack and open source
docsPage.stack.visionValue: PyTorch-based visual feature extraction integrated into the document inspection pipeline
docsPage.stack.license: Licensed under the Apache License 2.0. Contributions are welcome through issues and pull requests.

result.heading: Analysis result
result.inconclusiveNote: We didn't detect enough evidence. The analysis confidence ({confidence}%) is low; prioritize manual reconciliation.
result.inconclusiveNoTextNote: We could not identify transfer data in this file. The analysis confidence ({confidence}%) is low; prioritize manual reconciliation.
result.action.DO_NOT_RELY_ON_RECEIPT: Don't rely on this receipt to credit the payment.
result.extractedEmpty: No structured data was extracted from this receipt.
result.checklist.missing: Not extracted from the receipt — verify manually.
result.checklist.present: Present in the receipt — compare it with your account.
result.technical.help.paddleocr-onnx: Extracts the receipt's text (amount, date, CBU/CVU, CUIT) via optical character recognition, run entirely server-side with no external services.
result.technical.help.exiftool: Inspects metadata embedded in the file (editing software, capture date) for signs of manipulation. Missing metadata does not imply authenticity.
result.technical.help.c2pa: Checks whether the file carries a signed C2PA credential declaring its origin — for example, that it was algorithmically generated or composited.
result.technical.help.mobilenetv3-embedd: Compares the file's visual appearance against a set of known-legitimate receipts using a neural network (PyTorch), to detect visual outliers.
evidence.empty: No risk signals were recorded for this receipt.
